description: Skill trigger prompts. expect=true means frontend-craft should be invoked; false means it should not. near_miss marks prompts that sound related but are out of scope.

prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for my bakery with a hero, the weekly menu, and opening hours.
Create a React dashboard that shows monthly revenue, churn, and active users for our SaaS admins.
Make me a personal portfolio site to show my photography work. I want it to feel editorial.
Write an accessible dropdown menu component in React with keyboard navigation.
The pricing cards on our site look cramped on mobile. Can you fix the spacing and layout?
Review the UI of my signup page and tell me what looks generic or broken.
Audit our marketing site for accessibility problems like contrast and focus states.
Set up design tokens and a color system for our Tailwind v4 app, with light and dark themes.
Add smooth page transitions and hover animations to my Next.js site.
Build an interactive 3D product viewer with three.js for our sneaker launch page.
Here's a screenshot of a website I love. Make our app's homepage feel like this.
Redesign our docs site so it doesn't look like every other AI-generated template.
Create a multi-step checkout form in Vue with validation and error states.
My page scrolls horizontally on small phones. Make the layout responsive.
Restyle the navigation bar in our Svelte app so it matches the rest of the brand.
Write an HTML and CSS page for a local climbing gym: class schedule, prices, and a booking button.
Build a sortable, filterable data table component for our admin panel.
Add a dark mode to my website and make sure the text stays readable.
Our app's typography feels off. Pick a type scale and fix headings and body text across the UI.
Make the frontend for an AI chat assistant: conversation list, message view, and composer.
Create an Astro blog theme with a clean article layout and a tag index page.
Make the empty, loading, and error states on our orders page look good and work properly.
Design and build a mobile-first web app screen for tracking daily water intake.
Can you critique this React component's design and suggest how to make it less cookie-cutter?
Build an Arabic version of our product page that works right-to-left.
Write a REST API endpoint in Express that returns the list of products from Postgres.
Design a database schema for a multi-tenant invoicing system.
Write three catchy headlines for our bakery's homepage. Just the copy, no code.
How do I use auto layout in Figma to make a button resize with its label?
Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs pytest on every pull request.
Add server-side input validation to our Next.js API route for creating users.
Write a Python script that deduplicates rows in a CSV by email address.
Write a Dockerfile for a Node 22 service and a docker-compose file with Redis.
Implement Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm in Go with tests.
Our webpack build is slow. Help me migrate the bundler config to Vite.
Fix the bug where our Redux reducer mutates state when removing a todo.
How do I squash my last five commits into one?
Write the meta description and alt text strategy document for our marketing team, no code changes.
Fix the crash in our Swift iOS app when the user rotates the device.
Review our auth middleware for JWT validation vulnerabilities.
Write unit tests for the date formatting utility in utils/date.ts.
Explain the difference between TCP and UDP.
Make a spreadsheet that tracks our monthly marketing budget by channel.
Give me ideas for a logo for my coffee shop. I'll make it myself in Illustrator.
Write a bash script that backs up my home directory to an S3 bucket nightly.
Set up GraphQL resolvers for the products and orders types in our Apollo server.
Upgrade React from 17 to 18 in package.json and fix the breaking type errors in our hooks.
Draft a launch announcement email for our new dashboard feature.
Fine-tune a small text classifier on our support tickets dataset.
Our Node server's response time spiked. Help me profile the slow database queries.
